newsitem.title: USA: Voxel unsure when product will reach market.
newsitem.headline: Voxel unsure when product will reach market.

text.p: Voxel President and Chief Executive Officer Allan Wolfe said he is unsure when the company will be able to correct a problem with the camera printer part of its Digital Holography System that has held up shipments.
However, he said Voxel has taken steps to resolve the problem with the manufacturer and has also started considering alternative manufacturers.

Voxel's Digital Holography System improves on the data typically collected by CT and MRI scanners by producing three- dimensional rather than flat images. While the system had been widely endorsed as a way to improve medical diagnostics, the problem with the camera printer has held up deliveries, and, Wolfe said, kept the company's stock price depressed.

"I am optimistic we will resolve the problems with (the existing manufacturer, but am also committed to making alternative arrangements if necessary," Wolfe said. "We will have the product on the market; unfortunately, I cannot say when."
